title: Abby Phillip SHREDS MAGA Pundit's Defense in BRUTAL CNN Debate
description:
A CNN NewsNight panel discussion completely unravels the moment one simple question gets asked, and nobody at the table has an answer.

In this segment, Abby Phillip moderates a heated roundtable debate about the ongoing conflict involving Iran, the Strait of Hormuz, and the American military commitment that has now stretched past the five month mark. What starts as a routine political panel about midterm election pressure turns into something far more revealing, as conservative and liberal panelists clash over whether this war has any definable objective at all.

The debate opens with a denial that the upcoming midterm elections factor into military decision making. Keith immediately pushes back, arguing that political calculation has been present from the very beginning. He then lays out the origin of the decision itself, describing a situation room meeting at the White House and the claim that Pentagon officials warned that Iran would attempt to close the Strait of Hormuz. According to Keith, those warnings were ignored, and Republican leaders in Congress are now privately raising alarms about the political cost heading into November.

What follows is one of the more striking moments of the segment. A clip from Fox News is played on air, in which the network's own commentary acknowledges that the war is already unpopular, that Republicans are nervous, and that there is no clear path to an ending. The panel then moves into a discussion of shifting targets, Pickaxe Mountain,
